request: Wii pointer trails the Windows mouse cursor; minimize input-to-display latency
measurement: PrimeInputLatency (KPAD read -> XFB copy decoded -> VI handoff -> surface Present) plus Aurora [present-latency] stage timing; unattended hangar runs.
findings: Pointer came from the last SDL motion event, pumped once per retrace: up to one frame stale at the KPAD read.
Prime flips to a finished XFB from its GPU-done breakpoint callback, so the copy was shown at the retrace after next: copy_to_vi ~16.4 ms.
Present() blocks ~11-15 ms on D3D12 in Immediate, Mailbox and Fifo, windowed, borderless and exclusive alike; worker seal/encode ~0.6-0.8 ms, presenter queue/acquire/submit < 0.2 ms.
Pointer mapped to the whole window although the game image is letterboxed by aspect.
changes: KPAD read samples the OS cursor (GetCursorPos/ScreenToClient) at the read instead of the last SDL event.
Pointer coordinates are relative to Aurora's presented image rectangle (aurora_get_present_viewport_fraction); outside it the remote points off-screen.
WII_COMPILED_PRIME_PRESENT_ON_COPY=1 (launcher default): a decoded XFB copy is presented at the guest thread's next safe VI poll; the ready tracker prevents a second present at the retrace.

results_input_to_present_avg_ms.before_estimate: ~45-55 (stale pointer up to 16 + frame ~17-20 + VI wait ~16 + Present ~11)

pending: User QA of feel and alignment of reticle under the cursor; Present blocking inside Dawn D3D12 not resolved.
